newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Police quiz pensioner without licence to kill.
newsitem.headline: Police quiz pensioner without licence to kill.

text.p: Belgian police questioned a pensioner whose hobby was making 007-style firearms disguised as ball-point pens, La Derniere Heure newspaper reported on Thursday.
The .22 calibre weapons, deadly at a range of 25 metres (yards), have been selling for 1,000 francs ($27) each.
The 67-year-old told police at first he had made only about 10 of the clandestine guns, but eventually admitted having had about 50 clients.
The newspaper said the man was released earlier this week after promising to hand over a list of his clients and to avoid the company of gun enthusiasts and collectors.
